worker.reason: The registration previously named no worker because the seat had not written one. It is now an INPUT and is sha-pinned like every other input, so the lead runs the exact bytes the fake-path gate exercised.
worker.self_pin_note: The worker EXCLUDES its own path from the drift set and checks it separately (verify_self), recording worker_provenance on every row. A self-pinned file inside its own drift set can never be edited without a same-breath re-amendment, and the two failures — "an input moved" vs "the worker is not the reviewed bytes" — are different facts.
